purpose: Test whether Pyomo 6.10.1's legacy-compatible nl_v1 writer restores the Candidate A1 tax-zero convergence path under IDAES 2.12.
interpretation: The smaller first step observed in the one-iteration nl_v1 control does not lead to convergence when the run is extended to 100 iterations.
The final iterate is materially displaced from the archived/published solution and cannot be accepted as a reproduction.
Selecting nl_v1 alone is not a compatibility fix for the IDAES 2.12 optimization failure.
The scaling-suffix warnings provide evidence that inherited scaling metadata and the exported NLP are misaligned and motivate an explicit active-NLP scaling policy.
